summary: QRU Online public presentation layer fully validated. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass; full end-to-end Playwright UI walkthrough passes every acceptance criterion (public home, catalog, book page, invalid-id 404, Factory-route redirect while logged out, /login renders).

per_feature_verdict.public_home_at_root: PASS — Unauthenticated GET / returns qru-home (no redirect to /login). Treasure Standard signal + Featured Titles visible. No Factory admin UI leaks.
per_feature_verdict.public_catalog: PASS — /catalog renders qru-catalog with exactly 4 catalog-book-<id> cards; header states '4 authorized titles'.
per_feature_verdict.book_detail_page: PASS — Clicking a catalog card navigates to /book/:id; book-cover, book-title, book-description, book-price ($12.99), and disabled book-availability ('Available soon') all render.
per_feature_verdict.invalid_book_id_graceful: PASS — /book/does-not-exist shows book-not-found; backend GET /api/public/books/does-not-exist → 404 with only {detail} (no data leak).
per_feature_verdict.factory_routes_blocked_when_logged_out: PASS — /knowledge, /manufacture, /book-manufacturing, /products, /governance all redirect to public qru-home (no Factory content shown).
per_feature_verdict.public_api_readonly_no_auth: PASS — /api/public/home, /api/public/books, /api/public/books/{id} all return 200 with NO auth. Forbidden fields (provenance, product_manifest, working_copy, revision_history, publication_status, founder_authorization, manuscript, artifacts, quality_gates) verified NOT present in any response payload.
per_feature_verdict.founder_login_render: PASS — /login renders the Enterprise Access login form with email/password inputs; Founder Access hint (temporary password) visible.
per_feature_verdict.public_nav_and_footer: PASS — nav-home, nav-catalog, nav-founder-login, qru-footer all render with Treasure Standard signal in the footer.
per_feature_verdict.cover_images_reachable: PASS — All 4 authorized book covers return HTTP 200/206 (bytes range) via the public CDN.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/public_site.py — Uses a single _PUBLISHED_QUERY = {founder_authorization.authorized: True}. Clean single gate; correctly excludes MongoDB _id via projection. Draft/unpublished works cannot leak. GOOD.

_public_book projects an EXPLICIT allow-list of fields (id, title, subtitle, author, genre, imprint, audience, cover_url, list_price, currency + detail extras). No Factory internals can be added accidentally without editing this function. GOOD constitutional pattern.
book_detail returns 404 with plain {detail} — no revealing of whether an id exists but is unpublished vs simply missing. Correct for a public API.

frontend App.js ModeRouter — Unauthenticated users → PublicRoutes; PublicRoutes has explicit catch-all <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/"/>}> so any Factory-path URL a public visitor tries collapses to public Home. Cleanly enforces the private-Factory boundary at the router layer, not just in individual pages. GOOD.

publicApi.js — axios instance without any Authorization interceptor. Guarantees no logged-in token accidentally leaks to public endpoints (would still be safe since public endpoints ignore tokens, but the isolation is clean).

MINOR: QRUHome hero uses a hard-coded Unsplash URL rather than a Founder-authorized asset. Not a security issue but inconsistent with the Treasure Standard promise ('Only what has been authorized for release'). Consider replacing with a QRU Press™-owned hero image or serving from /api/public.

MINOR: QRUBookPage price display assumes list_price is a number (uses .toFixed(2)). If a future book has list_price null but ebook_price/paperback_price populated, price block silently hides. Consider a fallback to ebook_price/paperback_price so a title with only per-format pricing still shows something to the shopper.
test_credentials: Did NOT attempt Founder login (per instructions, verified /login RENDER only).
seed_data_creation: None. All 4 authorized books were already seeded by main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public layer regression test at /app/backend/tests/test_qru_online_public.py — run `pytest backend/tests/test_qru_online_public.py -v`. 4 authorized books currently: The Understanding Tree (8469bcc5…), Ordinary Tuesdays (Factory Ready) (ca481a45…), Trading Battlefield Analogy (0dbd2b49…), The Heart as a Daily Circulation Pump (48405e16…). Public router catch-all forces every non-public URL to '/' when logged out; if tests fail after main agent adds new public routes, update PublicRoutes in App.js accordingly.
rca of the issue: No defects. All acceptance criteria for QRU Online iteration-1 verified end-to-end.
